preconditions.description: The input string must be non-empty and its length must not exceed 1,000,000.
The input string must consist only of digits.

postconditions.description: The output must be a correctly formatted expression with '+' and '=' inserted.
The sum of the left and middle parts must equal the right part.
None of the parts a, b, or c can have leading zeros.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"len(stdin) > 0 and len(stdin) <= 10**6","description":"The input string must be non-empty and its length must not exceed 1,000,000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin)","description":"The input string must consist only of digits."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == f'{a}+{b}={c}'","description":"The output must be a correctly formatted expression with '+' and '=' inserted."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"int(a) + int(b) == int(c)","description":"The sum of the left and middle parts must equal the right part."},{"id":"Q3","expression":"a[0] != '0' and b[0] != '0' and c[0] != '0'","description":"None of the parts a, b, or c can have leading zeros."}],"invariants":[]}
